The architecture

One objective in. Your entire function, moving.

Talk to Us

Skott sits at the centre. It reads every signal, activates the right agents, runs across every channel and closes every loop back to your goal.

What does your function actually need?

The right question changes everything.

Most marketing leaders are solving the symptom. Skott starts with the source.

Which marketing bet got you your pipeline, and which drained the budget?

Skott connects every channel to your CRM pipeline. It shows what’s attributing, what’s leaking, and where the highest-leverage reallocation lives before you ask.

Your team ships content every week. When did it last accelerate a deal?

Skott audits your content against pipeline data and buyer intent. It finds what should be working and isn’t. Then builds what’s missing and distributes it without a brief.

How much does your best salesperson know before the first word?

Skott builds a live brief per target account funding signals, hiring patterns, stakeholder map, deal history. Your team arrives prepared. Every time. Automatically.

When output doubles next quarter, what breaks first?

Skott runs the execution layer so your team owns the decisions. Creation, distribution, sequencing, publishing orchestrated. The output of a 30-person team without scaling headcount at the same rate.

From objective to outcome

This is how your function transforms.

HubSpot, GA4, Search Console, Ads, Slack, Semrush, Apollo, Clay, WordPress connect what you have. Nothing leaves. Nothing migrates. Your data stays in your environment.

Zero rip-and-replace — Skott is the layer that makes your existing stack intelligent.

Not a task. An objective. Skott reads your live data pipeline, traffic, campaigns, competitor signals and returns a ranked execution plan with reasoning, not just a to-do list.

Objective-first, always. Everything on the plan earns its place.

From 400+ agents, Skott calls what’s relevant to your goal: research, content, ABM, distribution, analytics. Build new agents at will or bring existing ones from any framework.

400+ agents · Activated by objective.

Content goes out. Campaigns run. Skott tracks every outcome against your objective: what moved, what didn’t, what to do differently. It doesn’t celebrate completion. It waits for results.

Every output loops back. Each decision informs the next one.

The question you’re already asking

Your data. Your agents. Your call. Always.

Sovereign, governed and model-agnostic by design, so every agent and every workflow stays yours.

  • Stays in your environment

    Skott deploys in your cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, or on-premise. No data leaves. No training on your proprietary information. 80% of enterprise deployments choose private cloud.

  • Governed at every step

    Every agent action is logged. Every output validated. Human-in-the-loop controls for every decision that matters. SOC 2 Type II. GDPR-ready. EU AI Act compliant path.

  • No lock-in. Ever.

    What you build on Skott belongs to you. Walk away with every agent, every workflow, every intelligence layer fully intact. We are the infrastructure, not the owner of what you create on it.

  • Any model. Any framework.

    OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source. LangChain, CrewAI, Agentforce. Skott runs them all under one control plane. You’re never dependent on one provider’s roadmap.
